# dist/

The CSVs here are the latest published quarter, one per level: the same attributes as the
shapefiles, without the geometry.

The shapefiles are assets of this repository's [GitHub releases](https://github.com/faeldon/philippines-psgc-shapefiles/releases),
one release per PSGC quarter. The latest quarter's are always at these addresses:

| Level | Shapefile |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | https://github.com/faeldon/philippines-psgc-shapefiles/releases/latest/download/PH_Adm0_Country.shp.zip |
| 1 | https://github.com/faeldon/philippines-psgc-shapefiles/releases/latest/download/PH_Adm1_Regions.shp.zip |
| 2 | https://github.com/faeldon/philippines-psgc-shapefiles/releases/latest/download/PH_Adm2_ProvDists.shp.zip |
| 3 | https://github.com/faeldon/philippines-psgc-shapefiles/releases/latest/download/PH_Adm3_MuniCities.shp.zip |
| 4 | https://github.com/faeldon/philippines-psgc-shapefiles/releases/latest/download/PH_Adm4_BgySubMuns.shp.zip |
| 4, complete | https://github.com/faeldon/philippines-psgc-shapefiles/releases/latest/download/PH_Adm4_BgySubMuns_complete.shp.zip |

Each release also carries its CSVs and a `SHA256SUMS` file to check the downloads against. Older
quarters are on the [releases page](https://github.com/faeldon/philippines-psgc-shapefiles/releases).
